title: Kestrel Closed-End Consumer Lease Maturity and Return Calendar
content:
**Kestrel Closed-End Consumer Lease — day counts and limits around the scheduled end, by tier**

| Tier | Options letter mailed, days before maturity | Extension months allowed in total | Extension request opens, days before maturity | Scheduled-end turn-in window opens, days before maturity | Advance inspection window, days before maturity | Complimentary advance inspections | Inspection dispute period, days after the turn-in inspection |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Kestrel Lease Tier 5 | 120 | 0 (no extension) | 60 | 90 | 90 | 1 | 14 |
| Kestrel Lease Tier 4 | 120 | 2 | 60 | 90 | 90 | 1 | 14 |
| Kestrel Lease Tier 3 | 120 | 3 | 60 | 90 | 90 | 1 | 14 |
| Kestrel Lease Tier 2 | 120 | 3 | 60 | 90 | 90 | 1 | 14 |
| Kestrel Lease Tier 1 | 120 | 6 | 60 | 90 | 90 | 1 | 14 |
| Kestrel Lease Tier 1+ | 120 | 6 | 60 | 90 | 90 | 1 | 14 |

All figures are calendar days except the extension months (whole months, counted over the life of the lease) and the number of inspections.

**What each column measures**

- *Options letter*: the lease-end options letter is mailed this many calendar days before the maturity date.
- *Extension months allowed*: the most months, in total, a lease may be extended month to month past maturity; a tier showing 0 cannot extend.
- *Extension request opens*: the calendar days before the current maturity date from which a maturity extension may be requested.
- *Turn-in window opens*: the calendar days before the maturity date from which a turn-in counts as a scheduled-end turn-in.
- *Advance inspection window*: the calendar days before the maturity date within which the complimentary advance inspection may be performed.
- *Inspection dispute period*: the calendar days after the turn-in inspection within which the lessee may dispute it.

**Hypothetical illustration**: for a lease in Kestrel Lease Tier 3 maturing on a given date, the options letter goes out 120 days ahead, the lessee may ask for an extension from 60 days ahead, and may extend by up to 3 months in total; the same lease in Kestrel Lease Tier 5 cannot be extended at all.
